## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#5` · `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C` · 2026-10-29T05:59Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27418, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27418" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27418` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27418 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{WAS:…}}` / the now-token). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27418`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes (`@object-ui/i18n` patch for namespace rows; app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.
Collision check: ui seats 1 and 2 both answered at 2026-10-29T05:56Z that neither holds an order, claim or plan on #27355 rows 12–13, and nothing of theirs is in flight in plugin-kanban or plugin-gantt. **Constraint (seat 1):** PR #27388 retires `ViewSkeleton` / `ShimmerSkeleton`; build no loading state on them. Measure open PRs on every file you touch at your first edit.

### Card

#27418 holds rows 12–13 of #27355 (HotCRM 18.2.0, phone width). Its body holds the seat's reading. Treat it as the mechanism assumptions to measure; disproof is welcome.
- **Row 12.** A phone kanban opens on column 0 even when column 0 is empty. On first load only, bring the first non-empty column into view. ⛔ Never move it after the user scrolls or picks a column. Keep the column order.
- **Row 13.** In `plugin-gantt` `GanttView.tsx` at 390px, find why a bar draws no label and why a long task title is cut with no ellipsis. The likely causes are a width threshold, or a flex child missing `min-w-0` / `truncate`.
- ⛔ Out of scope: a gantt column-title config key. That is #27386 row 2, a spec ask.

### Measure first

Use real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) at 390×844, with a fixture board whose first stage is empty and a gantt whose rows have long titles, before and after. Record:
- the column in view on first paint (its `scrollLeft` or the selected column);
- each bar's label text, and whether its box lies inside the bar or beside it;
- the title cell's `text-overflow` and its `scrollWidth` vs `clientWidth`.

### Scope

**File surface:** `ui/packages/plugin-kanban` (the phone column scroller only) and `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx` (bar labels and title cells at narrow widths), with tests beside each. Stop on any breach and explain it in the report.

**Tests (acceptance):**
- A phone board whose stage 1 is empty opens on the first non-empty stage.
- A board with cards in stage 1 opens on stage 1.
- A user scroll is never overridden.
- A narrow gantt bar carries its title.
- A long title ellipsizes.
- Ablation: revert each fix and its pin goes red.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate is expected; run `dispatch-gates --tier` and follow it. Use `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S–M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` are published, so each one you touch takes a `patch` changeset.
